name: LECITHINUM
common_names: Urine.--Scanty, with phosphates, sugar or albumen.
key_symptoms: Loss of appetite, thirsty, craves wine and coffee; bloated, sore pain in stomach rising toward throat.
Urine.--Scanty, with phosphates, sugar or albumen.
Sexual.--Male power lost or enfeebled. Anaphrodisia and ovarian insufficiency.
Aching, especially in occiput-pulsating and ringing in ears. Pain in zygoma; face pale.
Soreness, aching, lack of energy. Tired and weak.
